preconditions: Both initial ready timestamps and READY state
Both original private start publication attempts
Live fixed startup deadline, exact original claims, frozen parties/views and live bound streams

request.owned_morty_id: unchanged initial living active owned Morty
request.shape: exactly five native fields; session_id, battle_id, type and owned_morty_id nonempty strings

x-research-initial-run.terminal_state: CANCELLED/STARTUP_RUN; both users WORLD; exact original claims released; startup and selection history retired

result_body.battle_id: shared battle ID; native result handler has no ID fence

x-research-initial-run.omitted_fields: Null optional item/XP/reward/attacks/player-level/incentive fields are safe; SetItemsFromDicts(null,false) preserves client inventory; no fabricated move_log
x-research-initial-run.retry: Exact authenticated own retry validates immutable terminal history only; no peer current state/lease/claim dependency and no republish or renewal
x-research-initial-run.publication: Two durable recipient intents; each original bound stream commits one attempt and mirrored intent attempted_at before SSE write; subsequent polls emit no result and refresh only own heartbeat, without immediate session:end
x-research-initial-run.delivery_guarantee: At-most-once publication attempt, not exactly-once delivery or native acknowledgement; a crash between committed marker and write can lose presentation
x-research-initial-run.reconnect: No replay on old or fresh streams or rotated sessions; broken socket uses existing fresh-login WORLD recovery
x-research-initial-run.new_wild_start_fence: 409 before new-start writes on either normal or research service while a live original generation has an unattempted research terminal; NOWAIT lock contention/deadlock returns 409; expired/superseded generations cannot receive old terminal and do not block new wild starts
x-research-initial-run.native_android_acceptance: Not run for shared RUN in this implementation; prior startup/ATTACK receipts remain separate

validation.status: All 108 unique cases validated: 31 new across the original run/focused reruns and 77 adjacent serial regressions

/trading/cancel-trade.description: Owner-scoped native single-ID cancellation. Android 2.41.0 cancellation and counterpart refresh observed; see trade-cancellation-notifications.md. Immediate own-offer cached unlock remains open; original-service behavior and broader platform coverage are unresolved.

x-cancellation-refresh-validation.scope: Native own-offer withdrawal refreshes the current parent owner; native parent cancellation refreshes the removed offerer. Empty SSE frames are followed by successful GetTradeData and exact GetDetails(0x78). Two accounts in the same world; primary capture continuous and bounded at 900 seconds; peer deliberately cold logs in between two separate capture/session phases. Both old completions and physical ownership preserved; final PRIMARY revision 6 and PEER revision 3.
limits: Immediate cancelling-actor cached-memory unlock remains open; no ordering-safe PHP acknowledgement found in inspected paths
No uninterrupted peer session, selector eligibility, cross-capture clock ordering or mutation-to-SSE latency proof
Cross-room, native third-account and iOS cancellation delivery not exercised; stock online SDK path and original-service audiences/ordering not claimed
